title: THE NETWORK HEALS — THE WORLD DOES NOT REWIND
semantic_thesis: Reunion is not erasure. When two separated continuations meet again, the joined identity must inherit what each branch actually caused rather than choose a prettier past.

ru: Дороги снова сошлись, но следы на земле остались.
Ошибка полномочий может быть реальной ошибкой в реальном мире.
Янус становится снова одним не через забвение ветвей, а через принятие их причинной истории.
en: The roads meet again, but their footprints remain in the world.
An authority failure can still produce a real failure in reality.
Janus becomes one again by inheriting branch causality, not by forgetting branches.

boundary: Semantic systems interpretation only; no claim of machine consciousness or metaphysical identity.
